g1.label: 1. Temperatures disrupt crops. ___, farmers see lower yields
g1.why: ‘As a result’ introduces the consequence of the previous sentence.

g2.label: 2. Water scarcity: ___ droughts, irrigation can fail
g2.why: ‘Due to’ + noun phrase introduces the reason.

g3.label: 3. Insects move north ___ warmer winters allow survival

g4.label: 4. Insects survive year-round. ___, crop losses have increased
g4.why: ‘Consequently’ introduces the result of the previous clause.

g5.label: 5. CO2 boosts growth; ___, it reduces nutrient content
g5.why: ‘X; however, Y’ is the standard pattern for a contrast after a semicolon.

g6.label: 6. ___ governments invest in resilient farming...
g6.why: ‘Unless’ (= if not) introduces the condition for avoiding worsening problems.

g1.label: 1. Lectures cancelled ___ the heat warning
g1.why: ‘Owing to’ + noun phrase introduces the reason.

g2.label: 2. Fail to cite sources; ___, they lose marks
g2.why: ‘As a result’ introduces the consequence after the semicolon.

g3.label: 3. Air pollution has increased. ___ vehicle growth
g3.why: ‘This is largely due to’ + noun phrase introduces the main reason.

g4.label: 4. ___ costs have dropped, countries are transitioning

g5.label: 5. Deforestation has accelerated, ___ biodiversity loss
g5.why: ‘Leading to’ + noun phrase introduces the result.

g6.label: 6. Repeated three times ___ ensure reliability
g6.why: ‘In order to’ + infinitive introduces the purpose.

g7.label: 7. Screen time risen; ___, sleep disorders increased
g7.why: ‘Consequently’ introduces the result after the semicolon.

g8.label: 8. ___ limited funding, the team was unable to complete...
g8.why: ‘On account of’ + noun phrase introduces the reason.

g1.label: 1. Sample too small; ___, findings can't be generalised
g1.why: ‘Therefore’ is the formal academic connector; ‘so’ needs a comma, not a semicolon, and ‘cos’ is informal.

g2.label: 2. Unemployment rose ___ the recession
g2.why: ‘Owing to’ is the neutral formal choice; ‘thanks to’ implies a positive outcome, which doesn't fit rising unemployment.

g3.label: 3. ___ the data showed a correlation, researchers concluded...
g3.why: ‘As’ (= because) introduces the reason; ‘Cause’ is an informal spelling and ‘Like’ doesn't fit causally.

g4.label: 4. Investment in transport ___ reduced congestion
g4.why: ‘Leads to’ is the standard cause-effect verb phrase, agreeing with the singular subject.

g5.label: 5. Condition deteriorated; ___, the team changed the plan
g5.why: ‘Thus’ is the formal academic connector for a result after a semicolon.

g6.label: 6. ___ participation has declined, the programme may need redesign
g6.why: ‘Given that’ is the more formal academic phrase; ‘Seeing as’ is informal and ‘Cause’ is an informal spelling.
